newsitem.title: GREECE: PANAGIOTIS IATROU JOINS DIETHNIKI MUTUAL FUNDS AS NEW GM.
newsitem.headline: PANAGIOTIS IATROU JOINS DIETHNIKI MUTUAL FUNDS AS NEW GM.

text.p: Panagiotis Iatrou, formerly with National Mortgage Bank Mutual Funds has joined National Bank subsidiary Diethniki Mutual Fund Management as its new general manager.

Iatrou, 38, with an MBA in finance and marketing from the University of Texas brings his experience in fund management to Diethniki -- the second largest fund management company in the Greece's 3.7 trillion drachma mutual fund industry.
Diethniki with a market share of 14.57 percent managed assets of 542.6 billion drachmas based on end-November 1996 industry statistics provided by the Union of Greek Institutional Investors.
Iatrou's previous posts were with ABN AMRO Mutual Funds, Elais , Alpha Trust investment consultants and Agrotiki Life Insurance. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
